latHint: Think a higher male singing voice - not a fish.
pivHint: A BASS is a freshwater fish - but BASS is also a very low male singing voice, deeper than a ______.
winText: Sing out. BASS was the pivot - a fish to a TENOR.
lossText: TENOR - a high male singing voice. BASS was the pivot: a lake BASS to the deep BASS voice.
